note: Public leaderboard scores of the Part 2 submissions, copied from `kaggle competitions submissions` (public D2, power 1.5). Segment probes multiply one segment of a base submission; part2/probe_solve.py turns them into the best multiplier per segment.

versions.name: v0
versions.what: developed prior x one level per line

versions.name: v1
versions.what: v0 with new_business as a prior feature

versions.name: v2
versions.what: per-peril prior, shrunk peril levels (N0=400), motor gender and buildings age band corrections

versions.name: v3_half
versions.what: v2 x halfway (log) to the solved multipliers; the solver predicted 0.16433

versions.name: v4
versions.what: v2 with prior averaged over three variants, construction codes fixed, vehicle details dropped, gender on at-fault perils, total matched

versions.name: v5_full
versions.what: v4 x transferred segment multipliers (motor NB 1.437, buildings NB 1.218, contents NB 1.106, renewals 1.045/1.007/1.005)

versions.name: v6
versions.what: v5 x seven-parameter structured multipliers shrunk by sampling noise; the structure predicted 0.17512, so it over-extrapolated

versions.name: v7
versions.what: v5 x twelve cell factors (ridge prior, equation noise 2e-4, solved without the deviance constant) shrunk by sampling noise

versions.name: v9
versions.what: v7 cell totals on the prior average with the Tweedie 1.6 variant in place of 1.4 (transplant_cells.py)

versions.name: v10
versions.what: teammate's cleaned emerging files and feature list (renewal_count and vehicle details in all three priors), rescaled to v7's cell totals

versions.name: v11
versions.what: v10 times a motor residual booster (rating, history and premium columns, 50 rounds), rescaled to v7's cell totals

versions.name: v12c
versions.what: geometric mean of v9 and v10 times buildings fire x exp(1.662 (wildfire_index - 0.528)), the developed-market slope (fire_term.py, geo_mean.py), rescaled to v7's cell totals

versions.name: v13_raw
versions.what: v12c times the shrunk factors of seven motor segment probes on v10 (probe_overlays.py)

versions.name: v13_cells
versions.what: v13_raw rescaled to v7's twelve cell totals (final)

probes_on_v10.seg: motor NB region E01 or E06
